name: video subtitle remover
tagline: Subtitle Remover is an AI tool that erases hard-coded subtitles, captions, watermarks and on-screen text from any video
description: Subtitle Remover is an AI tool that erases hard-coded subtitles, captions, watermarks and on-screen text from any video. It reconstructs the pixels behind the text frame by frame — no blur, no black bar — and exports a clean 1080p MP4 in minutes.
